controles.affirmation: Litige crash aerien 2016 : en juin 2025, 43 individus ont depose une demande reconventionnelle au RU reclamant 16,7 M$ de dommages
controles.verbatim_source: In June 2025, the 43 individuals filed a counterclaim against Aon in the UK seeking damages. The claim is alleged to be governed in the alternative by the laws of three different jurisdictions and asserts damages in the amount of $16.7 million. (10-Q T2 2026, Note Claims, Lawsuits and Other Contingencies)
controles.correction_proposee: Aucune correction requise sur le fait. Reserve : le filing precise juste apres 'The claim alleges that certain aspects of the damages have yet to be calculated' et mentionne par ailleurs une requete anterieure a Miami-Dade 'for claims totaling $844 million'. Qualifier 16,7 M$ de 'montant limite a l'echelle du bilan' minimise une exposition non encore chiffree.

controles.affirmation: Le desendettement est engage depuis l'acquisition de NFP en 2023 / le goodwill vient d'acquisitions dont NFP en 2023
controles.verbatim_source: ACQUISITION OF NFP - On April 25, 2024, the Company completed its acquisition of NFP (10-K FY2024, depose le 18/02/2025). Le 10-K confirme aussi 'the delayed draw term loan was drawn upon in full in April 2024 to support the acquisition of NFP'.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer 'NFP en 2023' par 'NFP, finalisee le 25 avril 2024' (les deux occurrences : fondamental_interne #2 et #3).
